∀ {n : Nat} [NeZero.{0} n] (S : FDRep.{0, 0} Complex (Multiplicative.{0} (ZMod n))) [CategoryTheory.Simple.{0, 1} S],
  Exists.{1} fun ξ => Nonempty.{1} (CategoryTheory.Iso.{0, 1} S (Etingof.AbelianFDRep.charFDRep ξ))

∀ {n : Nat} [inst : NeZero.{0} n] (ξ : MonoidHom.{0, 0} (Multiplicative.{0} (ZMod n)) (Units.{0} Complex)),
  Iff (Etingof.IsComplexType.{0, 0} (Etingof.AbelianFDRep.charRep ξ))
    (And (Ne.{1} ξ 1) (∀ (hn : Dvd.dvd.{0} 2 n), Ne.{1} ξ (Etingof.ZModSignChar hn)))

∀ {n : Nat} [inst : NeZero.{0} n] (ξ : MonoidHom.{0, 0} (Multiplicative.{0} (ZMod n)) (Units.{0} Complex)),
  Iff (Etingof.IsRealType.{0, 0} (Etingof.AbelianFDRep.charRep ξ))
    (Or (Eq.{1} ξ 1) (Exists.{0} fun hn => Eq.{1} ξ (Etingof.ZModSignChar hn)))

source_text: For Z/n, all irreducibles are characters; exactly the trivial and, for even n, sign characters are real type, while every other character is complex type.
